City of Dalaran.title: Heart of Disruption
City of Dalaran.text: Bring back an Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage in Dalaran.
City of Dalaran.from: the Image of Archmage Modera at the Dalaran sewer gate

City of Dalaran.title: Heart of Disruption
City of Dalaran.text: Bring an Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage to Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
City of Dalaran.from: the Image of Archmage Modera at the Dalaran sewer gate

City of Dalaran.title: Power Overwhelming
City of Dalaran.text: High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind wants the Arcanic Enigma destroyed.
City of Dalaran.note: The creature itself is named the Arcanic Enigma; it walks the Path of Renewal in the north-east of the streets, with two Mana Phantoms.

City of Dalaran.title: A Green Sample
City of Dalaran.text: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the fel garden for Shylamiir in Stormwind.

City of Dalaran.title: Starving Arcane
City of Dalaran.text: Kill 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants and 8 Mana Echoes for the Image of Archmage Modera outside Dalaran.
City of Dalaran.from: the Image of Archmage Modera outside Dalaran
City of Dalaran.note: They roam the streets above the sewers. One visit may not hold enough of them.

City of Dalaran.title: The Grave Knight
City of Dalaran.text: Melisara in Tarren Mill wants Atrexis the Grave Knight killed in the sewers.

City of Dalaran.title: Source of Power
City of Dalaran.text: Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores from Fragmented Sentries for Doctor Martin Felben in the Undercity.
City of Dalaran.from: Doctor Martin Felben in the Undercity
City of Dalaran.note: On the streets, around the Magus Commerce Exchange. Some lie broken and are simply searched; a visit holds a dozen or so.

City of Dalaran.title: Opportunistic Education
City of Dalaran.text: Bring the book The Founding of Dalaran to Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
City of Dalaran.from: Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance
City of Dalaran.note: A book to pick up, not a drop: past the portal room, in the bookshelves on the back wall of the Atrium of Fortune.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: Abominable Creatures
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Bring the Head of the Baron to Captain Truman, just inside the entrance.
Ruins of Lordaeron.from: Captain Truman, just inside the entrance
Ruins of Lordaeron.note: The abomination itself is named the Baron; he keeps the arena in King's Alley.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: Bloodied Insignia
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias for General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind.
Ruins of Lordaeron.note: The insignias drop from the undead throughout the ruins.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: Crest of Lordaeron
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Deliver the Crest of Lordaeron, found inside, to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind.
Ruins of Lordaeron.item: the Crest of Lordaeron, found inside
Ruins of Lordaeron.note: The crest hangs in one of about five places, a different one each visit: behind the banshee's crypt door by the fountain, in and behind the towers on Bjork's round, atop the tower by the spiders, or atop the tower after The Abandoned.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: Crest of Lordaeron
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Deliver the Crest of Lordaeron, found inside, to Oran Snakewrithe in the Undercity.
Ruins of Lordaeron.item: the Crest of Lordaeron, found inside
Ruins of Lordaeron.note: The crest hangs in one of about five places, a different one each visit: behind the banshee's crypt door by the fountain, in and behind the towers on Bjork's round, atop the tower by the spiders, or atop the tower after The Abandoned.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: Remember That I Love You
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Deliver the blood-stained letter found near Rath'mael to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind.
Ruins of Lordaeron.item: a blood-stained letter, found near Rath'mael

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Kill Rath'mael and report back to Deathguard Kristof in Brill.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: Light's Justice
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Collect 25 Intact Limbs from the undead inside for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
Ruins of Lordaeron.note: The limbs drop from the undead throughout the ruins, often several from one.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: A Frightened Request
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Find out what became of Edward Heartweaver for Tabitha Heartweaver in Silverpine; his body lies near Rath'mael.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: The New Plague
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Bring the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang to Theodore Griffs in the Undercity.

Ruins of Lordaeron.title: Unending Torment
Ruins of Lordaeron.text: Deliver the Abominable Head, dropped by the Baron, to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Ruins of Lordaeron.item: the Abominable Head, dropped by the Baron
Ruins of Lordaeron.note: The abomination itself is named the Baron; he keeps the arena in King's Alley. Everyone loots a head of their own.

The Hall of Thanes.title: An Ancient Grudge
The Hall of Thanes.text: Lay the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest for the Ghostly Attendant inside.

The Hall of Thanes.title: Important Heirlooms
The Hall of Thanes.text: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms for Thom Filch in Ironforge.
The Hall of Thanes.note: The heirlooms lie in urns and chests along the way; the vaults of the last room, the Reliquary of Kings, hold enough for a whole party.

The Hall of Thanes.title: Old Ironforge Incursion
The Hall of Thanes.text: Kill Durgen Dirgehammer and bring back his head for Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.

The Hall of Thanes.title: The Restless Dead
The Hall of Thanes.text: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions and 10 Tormented Souls for Afadra Dunwall in Ironforge.
The Hall of Thanes.note: The ghosts haunt the first chambers, around the first tomb.

The Hall of Thanes.title: The Treaty of Understanding
The Hall of Thanes.text: Bring the stone tablet from the vault behind the last room to King Magni Bronzebeard.
The Hall of Thanes.from: a stone tablet in the vault behind the last room

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Lost in the Thicket Things
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Find Ardin Grassman inside the dig for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.note: He is on a wooden platform beside the Relic Guardian's arena, at the Site of the Guardian.

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Heartwoven
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Return from Ardin Grassman, inside the dig, to Caitlin in Menethil Harbor.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.note: He is on a wooden platform beside the Relic Guardian's arena, at the Site of the Guardian.

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Songblade Search
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Find Daewyn Songblade inside for his brother Dorin in Lakeshire.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.note: His body lies in a tent in the Dragonmaw camp at the Lost Dig Site, shortly after Shadetooth.

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Fallen in the Fen
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Bring news of Daewyn Songblade, whose body lies inside, to Dorin in Lakeshire.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.note: His body lies in a tent in the Dragonmaw camp at the Lost Dig Site, shortly after Shadetooth.

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Horrors in the Highland
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Kill the Highland Horror and bring its rootcore to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.from: Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Highland Hides
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Bring 4 Thicket Raptor Hides to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.note: The raptors of Stalker's Thicket, after Saltspine.

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Lost Relic Carry
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Carry the Titan Relic from the Relic Guardian to Prospector Whelgar.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.item: the Titan Relic, from the Relic Guardian

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Changing Tastes
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Bring 4 Thicket Raptor Meat to Borstan in Orgrimmar.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.note: The raptors of Stalker's Thicket, after Saltspine.

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Open the Maw
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Kill 2 Dragonmaw Saboteurs and 4 Warders and take the Dragonmaw Dispatch from a Thaumaturgist, for the Deathstalker Agent in the Wetlands.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.from: the Deathstalker Agent in the Wetlands
Excavation Site: Wetlands.note: The Dragonmaw camp at the Lost Dig Site, between Shadetooth and the Highland Horror.

Excavation Site: Wetlands.title: Elder Knowledge
Excavation Site: Wetlands.text: Take the Titan Relic from the Relic Guardian to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Excavation Site: Wetlands.item: the Titan Relic, from the Relic Guardian

The Drowned City.title: Shady Saltseers
The Drowned City.text: Collect 10 Voodoo-Infused Artifacts from the Saltseer pirates.
The Drowned City.note: The pirates of Captain Dreadrise's crew.

The Drowned City.title: The Saltseer Captain
The Drowned City.text: Kill Captain Dreadrise and 3 Saltseer Coroners.

The Drowned City.title: Magics of the Drowned City
The Drowned City.text: Collect 5 I'lalai Fetishes from the trolls inside.

The Drowned City.title: Take Two With Water
The Drowned City.text: Make rubbings of the four Tablets of I'lalai.

The Drowned City.title: Ancient Gurubashi Secrets
The Drowned City.text: Recover the Ancient Gurubashi Idol from Deathless Marrow.
The Drowned City.from: Archmage Timear in the Alterac Mountains

The Drowned City.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol
The Drowned City.text: Bring the Ancient Gurubashi Idol from Deathless Marrow to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.

The Drowned City.title: The Drowned City
The Drowned City.text: Make rubbings of the four tablets.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Eye of Mugg
Krol'dok Stronghold.text: Bring the Eye of Mugg to Commander Brant in the Riverglades as proof the leader is dead.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Eye of Mugg
Krol'dok Stronghold.text: Bring the Eye of Mugg to Krom'rosh in the Riverglades as proof the leader is dead.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Tome of Twilight
Krol'dok Stronghold.text: Kill Nar'gurk and recover the Tome of Twilight for Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Tome of Twilight
Krol'dok Stronghold.text: Recover the Tome of Twilight from Nar'gurk.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Twilight Mementos
Krol'dok Stronghold.text: Collect 8 bangles from the Twilight's Hammer cultists inside.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Vengeance of the Highborne
Krol'dok Stronghold.note: He stands on the way up the hill, after Tunk the ogre smith and before the long wooden bridge.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: A Token of Vengeance
Krol'dok Stronghold.text: Collect 15 Cultist Ears from the Twilight's Hammer inside.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Krol'dok Moulding
Krol'dok Stronghold.text: Find someone in Farholde Keep who knows about the moulding looted inside.
Krol'dok Stronghold.note: Tunk, an ogre smith on the path up the hill, carries the moulding.

Krol'dok Stronghold.title: Krol'dok Moulding
Krol'dok Stronghold.text: Find someone in Rog'mar who knows about the moulding looted inside.
Krol'dok Stronghold.note: Tunk, an ogre smith on the path up the hill, carries the moulding.

Blackmaw Hold.title: Get to the Roots of It
Blackmaw Hold.text: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside for Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.

Blackmaw Hold.title: Get to the Roots of It
Blackmaw Hold.text: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside for Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.

Blackmaw Hold.title: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore
Blackmaw Hold.text: Bring the Claws of the Great Bear and the Tusks of the Unbroken to Ogtinc in Azshara.

Blackmaw Hold.title: The Twin Bears
Blackmaw Hold.text: Find the Totem of Ursoc and the Totem of Ursol for Lorekeeper Nok.

Blackmaw Hold.title: Blackmaw Magic
Blackmaw Hold.text: Take the Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Elder Shaman Bloodmane.

Blackmaw Hold.title: Blackmaw Magic
Blackmaw Hold.text: Take the Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Elder Shaman Bloodmane.

Blackmaw Hold.title: Blackmaw Pouches
Blackmaw Hold.text: Recover 5 Blackmaw Pouches for Ekkal in the Ruins of Eldarath, Azshara.
Blackmaw Hold.from: Ekkal in the Ruins of Eldarath, Azshara

Alcaz Prison.title: The Man in the Iron Chains
Alcaz Prison.text: Take the Alcaz Shackle Key from The Questioner.

Alcaz Prison.title: More Valuable Than Gold
Alcaz Prison.text: Use Mason Connery's note to find his hidden treasure.
Alcaz Prison.note: The treasure is not in the prison: it is under a loose floorboard upstairs in the inn at Moonbrook, Westfall.

Alcaz Prison.title: A Bit of Wet Work
Alcaz Prison.text: Kill 15 Strashaz Soldiers and 8 Strashaz Enchantresses and bring Tidemistress Ca'zass's head to Sully McCleary.

Alcaz Prison.title: A Little Payback
Alcaz Prison.text: Kill 15 Strashaz Soldiers and 8 Strashaz Enchantresses and bring Tidemistress Ca'zass's head to Sergeant Ulka.

Alcaz Prison.title: Blood Red Bandanas
Alcaz Prison.text: Collect 8 Blood Red Bandanas from the human guards.

Alcaz Prison.title: No Orc Left Behind
Alcaz Prison.text: Find Commander Folkar in the cells beneath the keep and free him, for Sergeant Ulka outside.
Alcaz Prison.note: He is chained in the cells inside the prison.

Alcaz Prison.title: The Honor of the Kor'kron
Alcaz Prison.text: Find the captive Varian Wrynn for Commander Folkar.
Alcaz Prison.note: Varian is not there: a note lies on the floor of the hidden room behind Blazeroar.

Alcaz Prison.title: Thrall Needs to Know
Alcaz Prison.text: Carry word of Varian Wrynn's fate to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

The Shaper's Terrace.title: Mapping the Way Forward
The Shaper's Terrace.text: Visit the landmarks and fill in the explorer's map at each.
The Shaper's Terrace.note: The landmarks: the Pillar of Assimilation, the Achromatic Crystal, the Western Gates, the Regrowth Vestibule and the Unearthed Stone Watcher.

The Shaper's Terrace.title: Panic at the Digsite
The Shaper's Terrace.text: Kill Venomridge, Ravasaur Matriarchs and Ironhide Ravasaurs.

The Shaper's Terrace.title: Crystalline Elements
The Shaper's Terrace.text: Bring one each of the Moist, Charged, Noxious and Fiery Crystals to Mayena Earthseeker.

The Shaper's Terrace.title: Essence of Seeping Slimes
The Shaper's Terrace.note: The slimes live in the pools by the Achromatic Crystal.

The Shaper's Terrace.title: The Dark Crystal
The Shaper's Terrace.text: Gather a Drained Crystal Fragment near the Achromatic Crystal.

Deadmines.title: Destruction in Deadmines
Deadmines.text: Find the hidden forge in the Deadmines and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives beside it, then meet Alba Fairmoon at the exit.

Deadmines.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade
Deadmines.text: Bring Trevan Rol his Weapon Notes, Whitestone Oak Lumber, an Enchanted Silver Ingot and a Purified Kor Gem.
Deadmines.note: The Whitestone Oak Lumber comes from here. The ingot is in Shadowfang Keep, the Kor Gem at Blackfathom Deeps.

Blackfathom Deeps.title: Seeking the Kor Gem
Blackfathom Deeps.text: Bring back a Corrupted Kor Gem from the Blackfathom naga.
Blackfathom Deeps.note: These naga are in the caves before the dungeon's entrance, not inside. The Purified Kor Gem this pays is wanted for A Moon-Kissed Blade.

Blackfathom Deeps.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade
Blackfathom Deeps.text: Bring Trevan Rol his Weapon Notes, Whitestone Oak Lumber, an Enchanted Silver Ingot and a Purified Kor Gem.
Blackfathom Deeps.note: Only the Kor Gem comes from here (see Seeking the Kor Gem). The lumber is from the Goblin Woodcarvers of the Deadmines, the ingot from a table beside Archmage Arugal in Shadowfang Keep.

Razorfen Kraul.title: Elemental Aid
Razorfen Kraul.text: Defeat Charlga Razorflank and take the Tattered Note on the quilboar's plans.
Razorfen Kraul.from: Veyric Thunderhame in the Arathi Highlands

Scarlet Monastery.title: Past Due
Scarlet Monastery.text: Retrieve the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery library.
Scarlet Monastery.from: Magus Olvek in the Alterac Mountains

Razorfen Downs.title: The Coldbringer's Eye
Razorfen Downs.text: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer.
Razorfen Downs.from: Archmage Lan'dalock in the Alterac Mountains

Razorfen Downs.title: The Coldbringer's Eye
Razorfen Downs.text: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer.

Razorfen Downs.title: Agamaggan's Blood
Razorfen Downs.text: Get the Virulent Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Downs and bring it to Kog'thug the Brave in Desolace.

Zul'Farrak.title: The Witch Doctor's Head
Zul'Farrak.text: Kill Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring back his head.
Zul'Farrak.from: Archmage Lan'dalock in the Alterac Mountains

Zul'Farrak.title: Zum'rah's Head
Zul'Farrak.text: Kill Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring his head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.

Maraudon.title: Rot and Regret
Maraudon.text: Fetch a Vial of Earth Song Water from Maraudon for Woodwyrd in Desolace.

Maraudon.title: An'she's Radiance
Maraudon.text: Recover the crystal An'she's Radiance from the top of a giant-guarded chamber past the Earth Song Falls.

Blackrock Depths.title: Fragment of the Firelands
Blackrock Depths.text: Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Blackrock Depths.

Shadowfang Keep.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade
Shadowfang Keep.text: Bring Trevan Rol his Weapon Notes, Whitestone Oak Lumber, an Enchanted Silver Ingot and a Purified Kor Gem.
Shadowfang Keep.note: The Enchanted Silver Ingot lies on a table beside Archmage Arugal. The lumber is in the Deadmines, the Kor Gem at Blackfathom Deeps.
